user_query: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
clean_summary: The original query hard-coded zeros for abandoned and purchase counts; introducing the proper SUM(CASE WHEN … EXISTS/NOT EXISTS) aggregations restored the correct counts.
database_memories: ENSURE: use COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopping_cart_events e2 WHERE e2.visit_id = e.visit_id AND e2.event_type = 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) for the “without being purchased in cart” metric instead of hard-coding 0 | CONTEXT: events table includes page_id, visit_id, event_type; shopping_cart_events includes visit_id, event_type; purchases with no prior add-to-cart events must be identified via NOT EXISTS | WHEN_TO_CHECK: When computing the “without being purchased in cart” count grouped by page_id | EXAMPLE_USAGE:
